business_problem: Trusting Social wanted to deliver personalized banking and financial inclusion at mass-market scale, but it needed a cross-border AI platform that could integrate its data foundation, support autonomous agents, and satisfy strict banking-sector security and regulatory requirements.
solution_summary: Trusting Social built Agent Foundry on Azure to extend its long-running data science platform into a generative AI environment for personalized banking. The implementation starts with a data foundation that integrates Azure Kubernetes Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics so operational data and warehouse insights can feed new applications quickly. On top of that stack, Azure Machine Learning and Azure OpenAI Service are used to build and train autonomous agents with Trusting Social's own models alongside models available on the Azure AI platform. The first agent, ALICE, uses this architecture to support onboarding, answer banking questions, and handle conversational cross-sales. Security is built in through strict data governance, Microsoft Sentinel for central logging, and WAF plus IDS/IPS controls for public-facing traffic, allowing the platform to satisfy bank-specific security settings without third-party add-ons.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Services
solution_components.role: Provides the application layer that Trusting Social integrated into its data foundation so new AI solutions can be developed and deployed quickly.

solution_components.name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL
solution_components.role: Stores application data that participates in the bank-facing generative AI platform and related digital journeys.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and prepares platform data so Trusting Social can build and scale AI-driven banking solutions.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Moves insights rapidly into the company's data warehouse for downstream banking and analytics use cases.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Builds and trains the autonomous banking agents with Trusting Social's own models and workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Supplies the generative AI capability used to power conversational agents such as ALICE.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Sentinel
solution_components.role: Provides secure central logging to support security monitoring and governance in financial-sector deployments.

data_flow: Trusting Social feeds operational and customer data through a foundation built on Azure Kubernetes Services, PostgreSQL, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics; Azure Machine Learning and Azure OpenAI Service then train and run autonomous agents such as ALICE, while Microsoft Sentinel and perimeter controls monitor public-facing interactions.
business_outcome: Trusting Social launched ALICE and its broader Agent Foundry platform to support personalized banking, helping one client lift credit card conversion rates by 10 percent, increase customer satisfaction by 42 percent, and raise spending among engaged customers by 10 percent while creating a secure foundation to scale AI agents across more than 130 financial institutions.
